Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: This is a specialized immunopeptidomics dataset. Standard bottom-up pipelines expecting tryptic digestion will fail. The search must be performed without enzymatic restriction and with strict peptide length filters (8-12 for HLA-I, 8-25 for HLA-II). The study also identifies 'cryptic peptides' from non-canonical genomic regions using a specialized tool (Peptide-PRISM).
